title: Create a Message (Messages API reference)
verified_facts: Endpoint: 'POST /v1/messages' (curl example: https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages). HTTP method POST.

Response usage object includes input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens; page states 'Total input tokens in a request is the summation of input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, and cache_read_input_tokens.'
Response stop_reason values include 'max_tokens' (limit reached).

title: Handle tool calls (Anthropic tool use)
verified_facts: Tool call in response: stop_reason 'tool_use' and one or more 'tool_use' content blocks with id, name, input.
Tool result is sent as a new message with role 'user' whose content has a block of type 'tool_result' with tool_use_id, optional content, optional is_error.
Formatting rule: tool_result blocks must come first in the user content array; any text comes after.
Page states tool results from outside sources are untrusted (indirect prompt injection).

title: Create a model response (Responses API reference)
verified_facts: Endpoint: 'post /responses' under base URL https://api.openai.com/v1 (curl example: https://api.openai.com/v1/responses). HTTP method POST.

Body parameters (optional per page): model ('Model ID used to generate the response, like gpt-6-astra'), input, instructions, tools, tool_choice, max_output_tokens, text, previous_response_id, store.
max_output_tokens: 'An upper bound for the number of tokens that can be generated for a response, including visible output tokens and reasoning tokens.'
Structured outputs: text.format with type 'json_schema' plus name, schema, and optional strict, description.
Response usage object: input_tokens, input_tokens_details {cache_write_tokens, cached_tokens}, output_tokens, output_tokens_details {reasoning_tokens}, total_tokens.

title: Function calling | OpenAI API guide
verified_facts: Function definition fields in 'tools': type ('function'), name, description, parameters (JSON schema), strict.
Tool call in response: the response 'output' array contains entries with type 'function_call', each with call_id, name, and JSON-encoded arguments.
Tool result is returned by appending an input item with type 'function_call_output', call_id, and output (a string) and calling again with tools.
Guide states: 'GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol require the Responses API for tool calling.'
Guide states callable function definitions 'count against the model's context limit and are billed as input tokens'.
Strict mode: strict true enforces the function schema; parallel_tool_calls false limits a turn to zero or one tool call.
